name: szk-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Dr. Szili Károly — context-window and token-economy tooling

plugins.name: memo-guard
plugins.description: Monitors the context window, archives the original losslessly at 70%/80%, compresses it into a queryable memo, and re-injects a ~500-token resume after /compact or /clear.

plugins.name: science-monitor
plugins.description: Tracks finished manuscripts by submission — journal, cover letter state, whether the package was actually sent, the decision that came back, and every reviewer point still unanswered. /sm:context pulls a manuscript's working context into the session in one step; /sm:review turns an incoming reviewer letter into tracked, answerable points.
